metadata.title: Sign up
metadata.description: Create your account and verify your email.

heading.title: Create your account
heading.description: Enter your first name and email to receive a secure magic link.

email.label: Email
email.description: We only use your email address to sign you in.

states.accepted: If this address can receive mail, we sent a sign-in link.
states.deliveryFailed: We could not confirm delivery. Please try again.
states.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.

summary.title: Please fix the errors below
summary.description: Review each field and try again.

firstName.max: First name must be 80 characters or fewer.
firstName.invalid: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes, or hyphens only.

locale.invalid: Select a valid language and try again.

form.invalidSubmission: We could not process your submission. Please review the form and try again.

invalid.title: This sign-in link is invalid
invalid.description: The link may be incomplete or malformed. Request a new sign-in email and use the latest link.

expired.title: This sign-in link has expired
expired.description: For security, links expire after 15 minutes. Request a new sign-in email to continue.

superseded.title: A newer sign-in link is available
superseded.description: Only the latest accepted link works. Open the newest email or request another link.

used.title: This sign-in link was already used
used.description: Each link is single-use. Request a new sign-in email if you still need access.
